criterionOutcomes.criterion: While Call details are loading, the dialog shows the standard loading state; when details are unavailable, it shows the standard no-data state; when loading fails, it shows the standard error state, with no incorrect Call data displayed.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: This verifies browser-local Automobile Call analysis loading/error UI, not naturally occurring backend failure or the whole dialog becoming unavailable. Supplied request audit scopes the read to POST https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/api/platform/automobile/call/test-analysis, pointId 132307934, excluding sampleTime requests; unmatched requests fall through. Record A is 132006263 (19/08/2026 09:34:39, 70 s); target B is 132307934 (09/09/2026 10:55:53, 11.941 s). criterion-7-prior-record-before-loading.png and criterion-7-prior-record-before-error.png establish A's distinct analysis before each transition. criterion-7-target-genuine-baseline.png establishes B's real populated response/UI. Holding B's original request produced the visible loading message/progress bar in criterion-7-simulated-loading.png; releasing it recovered genuine HTTP 200/22 samples per audit and the matching B analysis in criterion-7-loading-genuine-recovery.png. A separately injected synthetic HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, application/problem+json {title:'Service Unavailable',status:503}, produced the visible error and Retry in criterion-7-simulated-error.png / criterion-7-final.png. Both transitions retain B's correct summary and exclude A's prior chart/table; a failed call measurement is not being treated as a failed analysis request. The populated response establishes endpoint/record identity only. No actual empty response or authoritative empty-response schema was available, so unavailable/no-data behavior and its incorrect-data exclusion remain Blocked; no empty contract was inferred by removing populated arrays. The supplied cleanup audit states all owned pending requests were resolved, zero remained, and only the exact owned pattern/handler was removed and its absence checked before Retry. criterion-7-error-genuine-recovery.png corroborates recovered B analysis after the reported genuine HTTP 200/22 samples; criterion-7-cleanup.png shows removed UI selections. Handler removal is supported by that explicit audit, not proven by a page screenshot. Map viewport was changed and not restored exactly.

coverageChecks.assertion: Loading Call analysis shows standard loading state (simulated delay)
Unavailable Call details shows standard no-data state
Failed analysis loading shows standard error state (synthetic HTTP 503)
Loading state excludes previous record Call analysis
Error state excludes previous record Call analysis
Unavailable/no-data state excludes incorrect Call data
Original request recovers and owned handler is removed

reason: Independent assessment of cycle-003 attempt-001 Automobile / Call evidence; missing no-duration fixture and empty-response contract prevent complete coverage. Simulation is limited to analysis loading/error UI as disclosed in criterion 7.
